content.content: Markers persist across invocations in a single marker file. The file holds the markers and the position; a recording's snapshots live in the journal, not here.
content.rationale: Each CLI invocation is a fresh process, so markers kept only in memory die with it. One durable file for the markers keeps them across invocations; the file holds markers and the position alone, no snapshots, and stays untracked (S5-marker-file, IN-ignore). A recording's before/after content lives in the journal (D8c, kmmowvkw), so this file stays a pointer store.
